notes: Published article copy, Collins, Cordon and Julien (1998), pp. 133–146. Rendered primary Table 4 and sample text inspected. R² describes the full joint regression and is shared between simplicity and discipline descriptions for a given outcome. The paper prints predictor-specific coefficient P-values, but no same-test omnibus P-value for the reported R²; P left null. No effect conversion.
